headline: Nigeria Seeks Seven-Year Ban on New Federal Tertiary Institutions
summary: The Nigerian federal government has moved to halt the establishment of new federal universities, polytechnics, and colleges of education for seven years.
why: Fiscal policy adjustments targeting public education expansion aim to curb recurrent expenditure growth in government budgets.
